# @dragon-talon/dsh-openspec
English | 中文
> OpenSpec workflow skills and `/opsx-*` command aliases for DeepSeek Harness (DSH).
A Cordis plugin for DeepSeek Harness that registers the 12 canonical OpenSpec workflow skills under
their kebab-case names — so `/openspec-new-change` works natively through DSH's user-invocation inje
ction and the `skill` tool — plus the Claude-style `/opsx-<id>` command aliases as user-only skills
that resolve to the canonical body.

- 12 canonical `openspec-*` skills (model- **and** user-invocable)
- 12 `/opsx-<id>` command aliases

(user-only, content-identical to their canonical skill)
- No runtime state: skills are registered t
hrough DSH's skill registry, which owns uniqueness and lifecycle
## OpenSpec version
This package pins the OpenSpec workflow skills to **OpenSpec 1.14.1** (`@fission-ai/openspec`, sourc
e: `Fission-AI/OpenSpec`).
The skill bodies are generated by `scripts/sync-openspec-skills.mjs` from the OpenSpec repository's
`skills/*/SKILL.md` files. See Syncing skills.

## Usage
Once registered, both forms are available in DSH:

- Canonical: `/openspec-new-change`, `/openspec-apply-change`, …
- Aliases: `/opsx-new`, `/opsx-appl
y`, … (resolve to the same body)
### Configuration
[代码示例省略，未执行]
| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| `aliases` | `boolean` | `true` | Register the `/opsx-*` command aliases as user-only skills (`mode
lInvocable: false`). When `false`, only the 12 canonical `openspec-*` names are registered. |
